skill_name: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting two books.
workflow: The Catcher in the Rye by J.D. Salinger and To Kill a Mockingbird by Harper Lee are two classic novels that have had a lasting impact on literature and have been widely read and studied, despite being quite different in their approaches. Despite their difference in time period, geography and style, both of these books center around themes of innocence and judgment.
